title: Bolus requested through WearOS is not executed
symptom: After confirming the desired bolus on WearOS, a toast indicates 'treatment requested', but the treatment is never executed while close to the phone. The user does not receive a confirmation message on the watch nor see anything happening in the app on the phone.
cause: The user did not have an AAPS watchface installed, which is required for the bolus request to work.
fix: Install an AAPS watchface on the WearOS device. The user confirmed it started working after passing objective 3, but a maintainer stated that objectives are independent of this functionality.
evidence_quote: If you don't have an AAPS watchface it will not work, I have spent hours reseting and reinstalling until someone at Discord confirmed that behaviour...
